verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform, since such platforms can ship on-prem or self-managed editions, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Runpod's managed cloud (Secure Cloud, Community Cloud, managed Instant Clusters) and gives no installable, self-hostable version of the core platform. The open-source CLI and custom-container support are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
